Subject: Discovery recap: tool calling + structured output (JSON schema)

Hi Alex / Priya (looping Priya where relevant),

Thanks again for taking the time today — great convo. Per our call, I wanted to capture the key pain points, success criteria, and next steps so we're all aligned.

Summary of pain points we heard:
- Downstream systems frequently fail to ingest LLM responses because the output is freeform; engineering spends time writing brittle parsers and post-processing logic.
- Current provider responses vary over time leading to flaky integrations and customer-visible bugs.
- Need deterministic signals for tool/function calling (e.g., when to call payments API vs. returning structured JSON).

Current stack you described:
- Frontend: React app + edge functions
- Backend: Node.js Lambdas -> Postgres (Aurora) -> internal event bus
- LLM: currently a hosted provider (3rd-party) used for orchestration/assistant flows

What success looks like (from our discussion):
- Responses that validate against a JSON schema on the first pass (>= 95% parseable)
- Clear, reliable tool-calling markers so your orchestrator can deterministically run external actions
- Latency under 450ms p50 for the synchronous flows you mentioned
- Token cost improvement over current provider (target: >= 20% reduction)

Redwood-specific suggestions we discussed:
- Define a deterministic JSON schema for the agent responses (attached: proposed-json-schema-v1.json)
- Use function / tool-calling primitives with explicit success/failure signals and fallbacks
- Prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts to cut token costs and latency
- A short technical workshop to validate schema against sample payloads and run a small proof-of-concept (we recommend the dedicated 60-minute tech workshop)

Next steps (proposed):
1) I attached a short proposal and an initial JSON schema (redwood-tool-calling-proposal.pdf, proposed-json-schema-v1.json). Please review.
2) Can we schedule a 60-minute technical workshop next week to validate the schema and run a sample integration? I shared a Calendly link below — if you prefer, suggest two times that work for your engineering team.
3) Alex / Priya: please send a couple of representative sample payloads (typical user prompts + desired structured output) before the workshop.

Attachments: redwood-tool-calling-proposal.pdf; proposed-json-schema-v1.json

Looking forward — happy to iterate on the schema after workshop feedback.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

--
Note: attaching the proposal + schema for your review. If you'd like, we can run a short automated eval against a set of prompts you provide prior to the workshop.
